items.name: Sun
items.fact: The Sun contains 99.8% of all the mass in our solar system

items.name: Sirius
items.fact: Sirius is the brightest star in Earth's night sky and is twice the size of our Sun

items.name: Alpha Centauri
items.fact: Alpha Centauri is the nearest star system to Earth at just 4.37 light-years away

items.name: Proxima Centauri
items.fact: Proxima Centauri is the single closest known star to our Sun at 4.24 light-years

items.name: Betelgeuse
items.fact: Betelgeuse is a massive red supergiant star that will explode as a supernova one day

items.name: Rigel
items.fact: Rigel is a blue supergiant star 120,000 times more luminous than our Sun

items.name: Vega
items.fact: Vega will become Earth's pole star in about 13,000 years due to axial precession

items.name: Polaris
items.fact: Polaris is the North Star that always points north and barely moves in the night sky

items.name: Canopus
items.fact: Canopus is the second brightest star in the sky and is used to navigate spacecraft

items.name: Arcturus
items.fact: Arcturus is the brightest star in the northern sky and a bright orange-red giant

items.name: Aldebaran
items.fact: Aldebaran is a giant orange star 44 times the diameter of our Sun

items.name: Antares
items.fact: Antares is a red supergiant so massive that if placed where our Sun is it would reach beyond Mars

items.name: Spica
items.fact: Spica is a binary star system and one of the bluest and hottest visible stars

items.name: Capella
items.fact: Capella is actually four stars in two binary pairs all orbiting together

items.name: Deneb
items.fact: Deneb is so luminous it would outshine a crescent Moon if it were as close as Sirius

items.name: Fomalhaut
items.fact: Fomalhaut has a wide debris disk surrounding it with possible young planets forming

items.name: Regulus
items.fact: Regulus is a rapidly spinning star that bulges at its equator from its fast rotation

items.name: Castor
items.fact: Castor is a remarkable sextuple star system of six stars all bound together

items.name: Pollux
items.fact: Pollux is a giant orange star with a confirmed planet orbiting it

items.name: Procyon
items.fact: Procyon is a binary star that has a faint white dwarf companion orbiting it

items.name: Epsilon Eridani
items.fact: Epsilon Eridani is a young star similar to our young Sun and has a confirmed planet

items.name: Tau Ceti
items.fact: Tau Ceti is one of the most Sun-like stars visible to the naked eye

items.name: Barnard's Star
items.fact: Barnard's Star has the fastest proper motion across the sky of any known star

items.name: Wolf 359
items.fact: Wolf 359 is one of the faintest and smallest known red dwarf stars near the Sun

items.name: Luyten's Star
items.fact: Luyten's Star is a red dwarf with a potentially habitable planet in a close orbit

items.name: Ross 128
items.fact: Ross 128 is one of the quietest red dwarfs making its planet more habitable

items.name: TRAPPIST-1
items.fact: TRAPPIST-1 is an ultra-cool red dwarf hosting seven rocky planets including habitable zone ones

items.name: Gliese 667C
items.fact: Gliese 667C hosts multiple potentially habitable super-Earth planets around it

items.name: Kepler-452
items.fact: Kepler-452 is very similar to our Sun and hosts a planet often called Earth's older cousin

items.name: 55 Cancri A
items.fact: 55 Cancri A hosts five known planets including one giant in a wide orbit

items.name: HR 8799
items.fact: HR 8799 is a young star with four directly imaged gas giant planets around it

items.name: Beta Pictoris
items.fact: Beta Pictoris is surrounded by a huge dusty disk and has a planet already photographed

items.name: Eta Carinae
items.fact: Eta Carinae is one of the most massive stars known and will soon become a hypernova

items.name: VY Canis Majoris
items.fact: VY Canis Majoris is one of the largest known stars so big that light takes hours to cross it

items.name: UY Scuti
items.fact: UY Scuti is one of the largest known stars with a radius over 1,700 times that of the Sun

items.name: Stephenson 2-18
items.fact: Stephenson 2-18 is potentially the largest known star with a radius 2,150 times the Sun

items.name: R136a1
items.fact: R136a1 is the most massive known star at around 200 solar masses in the Milky Way

items.name: Pistol Star
items.fact: The Pistol Star is one of the most luminous stars known near the Milky Way's center

items.name: Peony Star
items.fact: The Peony Star near the galactic center may be even more luminous than the Pistol Star

items.name: LBV 1806-20
items.fact: LBV 1806-20 is an extremely luminous hypergiant star close to the Milky Way's core

items.name: Zeta Puppis
items.fact: Zeta Puppis is a hot luminous blue supergiant shedding mass in powerful stellar winds

items.name: P Cygni
items.fact: P Cygni is a luminous blue variable that brightened dramatically in the year 1600

items.name: Rho Cassiopeiae
items.fact: Rho Cassiopeiae is a yellow hypergiant one of the rarest types of stars in existence

items.name: HR Carinae
items.fact: HR Carinae is a luminous blue variable periodically undergoing violent eruptions

items.name: W Virginis
items.fact: W Virginis is a type II Cepheid variable star pulsating in size and brightness

items.name: Mira
items.fact: Mira is a pulsating variable star that changes from barely visible to very bright

items.name: Chi Cygni
items.fact: Chi Cygni is a Mira-type variable that grows to over 400 times the Sun's size

items.name: RR Lyrae
items.fact: RR Lyrae variables are used as distance markers across the Milky Way galaxy

items.name: Delta Cephei
items.fact: Delta Cephei is the prototype of Cepheid variable stars crucial for measuring distances

items.name: Beta Lyrae
items.fact: Beta Lyrae is a contact binary where two stars are so close they share their outer atmosphere

items.name: Algol
items.fact: Algol the Demon Star is an eclipsing binary that dims every 2.87 days

items.name: W Ursae Majoris
items.fact: W UMa is a contact binary where two stars are touching and share common envelopes

items.name: AM Canum Venaticorum
items.fact: AM CVn is an ultra-compact binary where white dwarf pulls helium from another star

items.name: Pulsars
items.fact: Pulsars are spinning neutron stars that emit beams of radio waves like a cosmic lighthouse

items.name: Magnetar
items.fact: Magnetars have magnetic fields a quadrillion times stronger than Earth's

items.name: Neutron Star
items.fact: Neutron stars are incredibly dense collapsed stars where a teaspoon would weigh a billion tons

items.name: White Dwarf
items.fact: White dwarfs are the dead cores of stars like our Sun that will slowly cool over billions of years

items.name: Black Dwarf
items.fact: Black dwarfs are theoretical cooled white dwarfs but none exist yet as the universe is too young

items.name: Brown Dwarf
items.fact: Brown dwarfs are failed stars too small to sustain hydrogen fusion in their cores

items.name: Red Dwarf
items.fact: Red dwarfs are the smallest and most common stars in the universe and can live for trillions of years

items.name: Yellow Dwarf
items.fact: Yellow dwarfs like our Sun are medium-sized stable stars that live for about 10 billion years

items.name: Blue Giant
items.fact: Blue giants are massive hot stars that live fast and die young in huge supernova explosions

items.name: Red Giant
items.fact: Red giants are aging stars that expand enormously as they burn the last of their hydrogen

items.name: Hypergiant
items.fact: Hypergiants are the rarest and most extreme class of stars with enormous mass and luminosity

items.name: Protostar
items.fact: Protostars are forming stars hidden in dense clouds of gas and dust before ignition

items.name: T Tauri
items.fact: T Tauri stars are very young unstable stars just beginning the process of nuclear fusion

items.name: Herbig Ae/Be
items.fact: Herbig Ae/Be stars are young intermediate-mass stars with disks of material still forming

items.name: Subdwarf
items.fact: Subdwarf stars are small dim stars fusing helium rather than the usual hydrogen

items.name: Subgiant
items.fact: Subgiant stars are just beginning the transition from main sequence to red giant phase

items.name: Wolf-Rayet
items.fact: Wolf-Rayet stars shed their outer layers in fierce stellar winds exposing their hot cores

items.name: Carbon Star
items.fact: Carbon stars have so much carbon in their atmosphere that soot-like compounds form

items.name: Technetium Star
items.fact: Technetium stars contain unstable radioactive technetium showing active nucleosynthesis

items.name: Lithium Star
items.fact: Lithium-rich giant stars are a puzzle as normal giants should destroy their lithium not keep it

items.name: Barium Star
items.fact: Barium stars have anomalously high amounts of heavy elements from a companion star

items.name: Ap Star
items.fact: Ap stars have abnormal amounts of certain elements and extremely strong magnetic fields

items.name: FK Comae
items.fact: FK Comae type stars are rapidly spinning giants with extreme star spot activity

items.name: Flare Star
items.fact: Flare stars are red dwarfs that produce powerful sudden flares brightening dramatically

items.name: BY Draconis
items.fact: BY Draconis stars vary in brightness due to large dark star spots on their surface

items.name: FU Orionis
items.fact: FU Orionis stars are young stars that suddenly brighten 100 fold due to disk accretion

items.name: EX Lupi
items.fact: EX Lupi stars are young stars with episodic outbursts caused by instabilities in their disk

items.name: Symbiotic Star
items.fact: Symbiotic stars are binary systems with a red giant and white dwarf interacting closely

items.name: Cataclysmic Variable
items.fact: Cataclysmic variables are binaries where a white dwarf pulls material from a companion

items.name: Nova
items.fact: A nova occurs when a white dwarf accretes enough material to trigger a thermonuclear explosion

items.name: Supernova
items.fact: A supernova explosion releases as much energy as the Sun will emit in its entire lifetime

items.name: Hypernova
items.fact: Hypernovae are incredibly powerful supernovae that may produce long gamma-ray bursts

items.name: Kilonova
items.fact: Kilonovae occur when two neutron stars collide creating all heavy elements like gold

items.name: Quasar
items.fact: Quasars are the most luminous objects in the universe powered by supermassive black holes

items.name: Blazar
items.fact: Blazars are quasars with a jet of material aimed directly at Earth

items.name: Seyfert Galaxy Core
items.fact: Seyfert galaxies have active galactic nuclei with bright cores visible at multiple wavelengths

items.name: Microquasar
items.fact: Microquasars are stellar-mass black holes that mimic quasar behavior on a smaller scale

items.name: Black Hole
items.fact: Black holes have gravity so strong that nothing not even light can escape from them

items.name: Sagittarius A*
items.fact: Sagittarius A* is the supermassive black hole at the center of our Milky Way galaxy

items.name: TON 618
items.fact: TON 618 is one of the most massive black holes known with 66 billion solar masses

items.name: Xi Persei
items.fact: Xi Persei is a hot blue giant moving rapidly through space creating a bow shock

items.name: Epsilon Aurigae
items.fact: Epsilon Aurigae is an eclipsed by a mysterious dark disk object every 27 years

items.name: KIC 8462852
items.fact: Tabby's Star dims in strange irregular patterns that still puzzle astronomers today

items.name: Przybylski's Star
items.fact: Przybylski's Star contains impossibly short-lived radioactive elements that should not exist

items.name: Thorne-Zytkow Object
items.fact: A Thorne-Zytkow object is a red giant with a neutron star hiding inside its core

items.name: HV 2112
items.fact: HV 2112 in the Small Magellanic Cloud may be the first confirmed Thorne-Zytkow object

items.name: SDSS J0002+6230
items.fact: This star has one of the fastest velocities ever measured being ejected from the galaxy
